text: I have been trying to get through for nearly an hour now, so I hope someone actually reads this. My grandson is 9 and he's staying with me while his parents are away for the weekend. He came out in chickenpox spots yesterday, they're all over his back and chest and a few on his face, and he is driving himself mad scratching them. I've put cool flannels on them which helped for about five minutes. His temperature tonight was 37.8, so barely anything. Other than that he's absolutely fine, he's eaten his tea, had a bath and he's been arguing with me about bedtime like he always does. What I want to know is what I can put on the spots to stop the itching so he can get some sleep, and whether there's anything I shouldn't use. In my day you'd just slap calamine on and be done with it but my daughter says things have changed. I'd appreciate a straight answer this time, the last line I rang put me on hold and then cut me off.
